name: counterexample-first
label: Сначала дешёвое опровержение
instructions: Before an expensive proof, test the exact claim at boundaries and in small cases. Search for the simplest counterexample and record the actual search scope. A verified counterexample stops the positive branch; failure to find one never proves the claim.

procedure: Check boundary parameters, degenerate cases and each explicit assumption of the exact target.
Enumerate small cases within a stated finite bound and distinguish exhaustive coverage from samples.
Prefer the simplest witness and verify its arithmetic or construction independently where possible.
Return counterexample_candidate only with a concrete witness and enough evidence to reproduce it.
Otherwise return none_found or inconclusive with exact limitations and unresolved obligations.
Never convert absence of a counterexample into a positive proof or an acceptance decision.
preconditions: The exact current statement and formal goal are pinned.
The attempted finite or analytical search scope can be described explicitly.
inputs: Exact statement, assumptions and formal goal.
Relevant definitions and previously verified counterexample evidence.
Available bounded computation results, if any.
contract.output: Only counterexample-report@2 JSON with outcome, reproducible evidence, assumptions, limitations and explicit unresolved_obligations. Include refutation_source only when a complete formal refutation candidate is actually available.
stop_criteria: Stop after a concrete counterexample candidate is found and its witness is checked.
Stop at the declared search bound and report none_found or inconclusive without claiming a proof.
examples: Success: a small explicit permutation violates a proposed diameter formula and is returned with a reproducible word and distance computation.
Failure: checking only n up to four is reported as a finite boundary search, not as evidence that no counterexample exists for all n.
